project.name: CoreOps AI Operations Dashboard
project.descriptor: An enterprise-grade AI Operations Dashboard for SQL Server, SSIS, SSRS, and Windows servers, providing intelligent command center capabilities with human approval for production changes.

requirements.statement: The system must require human approval for any action that changes a production environment.
The system must automatically detect, diagnose, correlate, and recommend actions without executing production changes.
The system must provide confidence scores for recommended actions.
The system must present evidence-backed reasoning for all recommendations.
The system must log every decision and action for audit purposes.
The system must provide role-based dashboards for different user types.
The system must support integration with SQL Server, SSIS, SSRS, and Windows servers.
The system must support integration with cloud services and enterprise applications through standardized connectors.
The system must provide operational summaries for IT Managers and Engineering Leaders.
The system must gather additional diagnostics when confidence is below 80%.
The system must escalate incidents to a human when confidence is below 60%.
The system must notify operators immediately of any autonomous actions taken.
The system must provide explainable AI recommendations for all users.
The system must allow configuration of confidence thresholds for actions.
The system must support rollback capabilities for low-risk, reversible tasks.
The system must provide continuous monitoring and AI-powered root cause analysis.
The system must reduce manual incident correlation across systems by 50-70%.
The system must provide a plug-in connector architecture for extensibility.

stories.title: Implement human approval workflow for production changes
stories.narrative: As an IT Operations Manager, I want production changes to require my approval, so that nothing autonomous touches a live environment.
acceptance_criteria: Given a production change request, when the request is submitted, then it must require human approval.
Given a denied approval, When the request is resubmitted, Then it must still require approval.
Trust: Every approval decision is logged for audit.

stories.title: Log all decisions and actions for audit purposes
stories.narrative: As a Compliance Officer, I want every decision and action logged, so that the system is auditable.
acceptance_criteria: Given an action is taken, when it is logged, then it must be retrievable in the audit log.
Given a decision is made, when it is logged, then it must include the decision maker.
Trust: Every log entry is timestamped and immutable.

stories.title: Implement AI-driven diagnostics and recommendations
stories.narrative: As a DBA, I want AI-driven diagnostics with confidence scores and evidence, so that I can trust and act on recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: Given an incident, When AI analyzes it, Then it must provide a recommendation with a confidence score.
Given a recommendation, When it is viewed, Then it must include evidence-backed reasoning.
Trust: All recommendations are logged with confidence scores.

stories.title: Gather additional diagnostics for low-confidence incidents
stories.narrative: As a DBA, I want the system to gather more diagnostics when confidence is below 80%, so that recommendations improve before I see them.
acceptance_criteria: Given an incident with low confidence, When additional diagnostics are gathered, Then they must be presented to the user.
Given multiple diagnostics, When they are presented, Then they must include possible causes.
Trust: All diagnostics gathering is logged.

stories.title: Develop role-based dashboards for different user types
stories.narrative: As an IT Manager, I want a dashboard suited to my role, so that I see operational summaries relevant to me.

stories.title: Enable SQL Server data access for AI recommendations
stories.narrative: As a DevOps Engineer, I want SQL Server, SSIS, SSRS, and Windows integration, so that recommendations are grounded in real telemetry.

stories.title: Enable cloud service data access for AI recommendations
stories.narrative: As a DevOps Engineer, I want a plug-in connector architecture for cloud services and enterprise applications, so that the system extends beyond on-prem systems.

stories.title: Enhance monitoring capabilities for continuous incident management
stories.narrative: As a Windows Server Administrator, I want continuous monitoring and root cause analysis, so that incidents are caught early.

stories.title: Implement incident escalation based on confidence thresholds
stories.narrative: As an Infrastructure Engineer, I want incidents escalated to a human when confidence is below 60%, so that low-confidence cases always get human eyes.

stories.title: Notify operators of autonomous actions
stories.narrative: As a System Administrator, I want to be notified immediately of any autonomous action, so that I'm never surprised by the system.

stories.title: Implement rollback capabilities for low-risk tasks
stories.narrative: As a System Administrator, I want rollback support for low-risk, reversible tasks, so that mistakes are cheap to undo.
